Lily was very happy. It was her birthday. She saw a big gift on the table. She wanted to open it. She ran to the table and tried to lift the gift. But it was too heavy for her. She could not lift it.

She asked her mom for help. "Mom, can you help me lift the gift? It is too heavy for me."

Mom smiled and came to the table. She lifted the gift and put it on the floor. She said, "This gift is from your dad and me. We hope you like it."

Lily thanked her mom and hugged her. She was very curious. She tore the paper and opened the box. She saw a beautiful doll inside. The doll had long hair and a pretty dress. She also had a hat and a bag. Lily loved the doll. She said, "Wow, this is the best gift ever! Thank you, mom and dad!"

Mom and dad hugged Lily and kissed her. They said, "You are welcome, Lily. We love you very much. Happy birthday!"

Lily played with her doll all day. She gave her a name and a story. She lifted her high and made her fly. She put her hat and bag on her. She pretended they were going on a trip. She had a lot of fun with her gift. She was very happy.

Once there was a little boy who was very cold outside. He looked up at the sky and saw dark clouds in the sky. He wanted to stay warm, so he had a plan. The plan was to put on his coat. He went in to find his coat and he saw a big dark coat. He put the coat on and it kept him warm and cozy.

He was happy and he smiled. Then he ran back outside and the dark clouds were still there. But, he was not cold anymore. He kept running around, playing, and having fun.

He was so glad he had a plan for staying warm. He just had to put on his coat and he was nice and warm.

Once upon a time there was a healthy little girl called Mia. Every morning Mia would go outside to play. She loved to imagine what she could be when she grew up.

Today, Mia decided she wanted to be an explorer. She had a big exploration bag ready, filled with all the things she thought she might need - a telescope, a compass and a snack for the journey. Mia was so excited she was ready to begin her adventure!

But then Mia noticed something was missing. "Wait! I forgot my hat!" she said. Without a hat to protect her head, she couldn't go exploring. She went back inside and looked in her closet.

Mia found a beautiful hat, made of the softest material she had ever felt. She was not sure what the hat would protect her from, but she knew it would make her look like a real explorer. She put it on her head and ran back outside.

Mia continued her journey, feeling safe and healthy. Everywhere she went she made new discoveries, as if she was an explorer of the world. She couldn't believe all the things she saw.

Eventually, Mia made it back home after her big adventure. She was tired, but she was so happy she had used her imagination and had gone out exploring. She knew she would never forget the experience.

Lila and Sam liked to play with their toy cars. They had many cars of different colors and sizes. They made zoom sounds as they moved the cars on the floor. Sometimes they had races to see which car was faster.

One day, they found a big box in the garage. It was heavy and had a picture of a train on it. They asked their mom if they could open it. She said yes, but they had to be careful. Inside the box, there was a train set with tracks, a locomotive, and some cars. Lila and Sam were very happy. They wanted to try the train set right away.

They cleared some space on the floor and started to put the tracks together. They followed the instructions and made a circle with a bridge and a tunnel. Then they attached the locomotive and the cars to the tracks. They plugged in the power cord and turned on the switch. The train started to move. It made a chug-chug sound and a whistle. Lila and Sam watched the train go around the circle. They saw it cross the bridge and disappear into the tunnel. They clapped and cheered.

They played with the train set for a long time. They took turns to control the speed and direction of the train. They pretended to be the conductor and the passengers. They had fun making stories about the train and its adventures. They forgot about their toy cars.

When it was time for dinner, their mom called them. They turned off the switch and unplugged the power cord. They picked up the tracks and the train and put them back in the box. They lifted the box and carried it to the corner. It was still heavy. They settled the box on the floor and closed the lid. They said goodbye to the train and thanked their mom for the gift. They ran to the kitchen to wash their hands and eat. They decided to play with the train set again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a big, thin sack that he carried everywhere he went. One day, Tim was outside playing when he saw lightning in the sky. He was scared, so he ran back home with his sack. 

When Tim got home, he saw that his mom had made him a sandwich. He put the sandwich in his sack and went to his room to play. He loved putting things in his sack and carrying them around. 

Later that day, Tim's friend came over to play. They had lots of fun together, but when it was time for his friend to go home, Tim realized his sack was missing! They searched everywhere, but couldn't find it. Tim was very sad. 

The next day, Tim's mom found his sack outside in the yard. It had fallen out of his pocket when he was playing. Tim was very happy to have his sack back and he hugged it tightly. From that day on, he never let his sack out of his sight.

Mark loves jazz. He likes to listen to the music and dance with his feet and hands. He has a big drum and a small horn that he plays with. He makes loud and fun sounds.

One day, Mark goes to the park with his mom. He sees a big dog with black and white fur. The dog is fierce. He barks and growls at Mark and his mom. Mark is scared. He runs behind his mom and holds her hand.

"Mom, what is that?" Mark asks.

"That is a dog, Mark. He is not nice. He is fierce. We should stay away from him," his mom says.

Mark nods. He does not like the fierce dog. He wants to play with his drum and horn. He sees a bench near a tree. He runs to the bench and puts his drum and horn on it. He starts to play jazz. He taps the drum and blows the horn. He makes loud and fun sounds.

The fierce dog hears Mark's jazz. He is curious. He stops barking and growling. He walks to the bench and looks at Mark and his drum and horn. He sniffs them. He likes the sounds. He wags his tail.

Mark sees the dog. He is not scared anymore. He sees that the dog is not fierce. He is friendly. He smiles at the dog.

"Hi, dog. Do you like jazz?" Mark asks.

The dog barks. He likes jazz. He likes Mark. He jumps on the bench and licks Mark's face. Mark laughs. He hugs the dog.

"Mom, look! The dog is nice. He likes jazz. He likes me. Can we keep him?" Mark asks.

His mom smiles. She sees that the dog is nice. She sees that Mark is happy. She nods.

"OK, Mark. We can keep him. But we have to give him a name. What do you want to call him?" she asks.

Mark thinks. He has an idea.

"Jazz. I want to call him Jazz. He is my jazz dog," he says.

His mom agrees. She likes the name. She likes the dog. She likes Mark's jazz.

Mark and Jazz are happy. They play jazz together. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy found some money on the ground. He was so happy! 

Timmy's friend, Billy, saw the money and said, "Wow, Timmy! You're so lucky! What are you going to do with all that money?" 

Timmy thought for a moment and then said, "I think I'm going to save it. My mom says it's wise to save money for a rainy day." 

Later that day, Timmy's mom saw him kneeling in front of his piggy bank. She asked him what he was doing, and Timmy said, "I'm putting my money in my piggy bank so I can save it for later." 

Timmy's mom smiled and said, "You're so wise for your age, Timmy. Keep up the good work!" And Timmy felt very proud of himself for being so smart.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys, especially her dollies. One day, Lily's mommy told her they were going to a lab. Lily didn't know what a lab was, but it sounded exciting!

When they got to the lab, Lily saw lots of people in white coats and machines that beeped and whirred. Her mommy explained that they were scientists who did experiments to learn new things. Lily thought it was cool, but then she saw a fake mouse on the table. It looked real, but it wasn't! Lily giggled and said, "That mouse is fake!" Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, it's just pretend." 

Lily had fun watching the scientists work and learned a lot about what they do in the lab. She was excited to tell her friends about her adventure when she got home. From that day on, Lily loved learning about science and all the exciting things that happen in a lab.

Once upon a time, there was a human. He was green and loved to lay in the sun. Every day, he would go outside and lay in the grass, feeling the warm sunshine on his face. He especially liked it when the sun was bright and yellow.

One day, he lay in the grass for so long that he fell asleep. When he woke up, he saw that he was surrounded by tall, green trees. He thought it was very special and decided to stay for a few more minutes.

As he lay in the grass, he felt so peaceful and content. He knew he would have to leave soon, but for the moment, he wanted to stay there forever. 

Finally, he opened his eyes, said goodbye to the trees, and headed back home. He was so happy he had taken the time to lay in the green grass and feel the sun on his face.

Once there was a pink bird who lived on a lake. Every day, the powerful bird would splash in the water and have fun. One day, the bird flew too close to the lake and fell in. She flapped her wings, but she was too scared to get out.

Suddenly, the bird saw a hand reaching out from the lake. It was her best friend, a powerful frog. He hopped over to the bird and said, â€œDonâ€™t worry. You can jump on my back and I can help you get out.â€

The bird jumped on the frogâ€™s back. The frog was so powerful, he swam and splashed until the bird was back on dry land. The bird thanked her best friend, and they both happily went on their way.

There was a figure in the window. It was tall and dark and it made Alexis shiver. She looked out of her window and saw it there. She tried to run away but the figure was too fast. 

Alexis couldn't believe her eyes. She wanted to scream but she couldn't. The figure was coming closer and the feeling of fear was all around her. 

The figure stepped closer and Alexis could smell something smelly. The figure was close enough now that she could see it was a scary witch. Alexis screamed and ran away as fast as she could. 

She ran to her room and closed the door. Now she was safe from the smelly witch. Finally, all the shivering stopped and Alexis felt safe again.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who wanted to escape its home. So one bright day, it left its tree and flew away.

The bird soared up and down until it found a huge tree with lots of ripe fruit. It ate some juicy apples and sweet oranges, then hopped around the tree looking for more.

But soon, the bird heard a loud noise from nearby. It was a serious bear, and it was looking for food! The bear was growling, and looked angry.

The little bird was scared, so it quickly flew away as fast as it could. It zoomed away from the big bear and flew back to its tree safe and sound.

The little bird was happy to have escaped the bear, and vowed to always stay away from serious animals. From then on, it was happy with just eating the delicious fruit from its own tree.

The peanut was the only one in the room. Everyone else was empty handed. The peanut was angry and confused. He looked around and saw no one else. Suddenly, the peanut heard a loud voice order him to move.

The peanut was scared, but he moved as the voice commanded. He slid across the floor until he saw an ignorant looking person. The person seemed to be looking right at him and shouted, â€œStay there, peanut!â€ 

The peanut did as he was told, and stayed in place. He felt silly and embarrassed standing out in the middle of the room alone. But then, something wonderful happened. The ignorant person reached down, picked up the peanut, and placed him in a warm, cozy jar.

The peanut was filled with joy. For the first time ever, he was safe. He was at home.

Once, there was a dead neighbor. Everyone was sad, so they decided to bury him. They dug a big hole and put him in the ground. They said goodbye and covered him with dirt, rocks, and flowers. 

The neighbor's family was sad, but they were happy he was now in a peaceful place. Everybody cried. 

Then, everyone gathered and held hands around the neighbor's grave. They sang a song for him and gave him lots of hugs. Afterward, they all went home knowing he was resting in a happy place. 

The family planted a tree to remember the neighbor. They said, "Whenever we look at this tree, we will think of our neighbor and our love for him." 

The tree grew big and strong and everybody was happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very adventurous and loved to explore the forest near her house. One day, she found a shiny ornament on the ground. It was so pretty that Lily decided to keep it.

But then, she realized that the ornament belonged to her friend, Timmy. Lily felt bad and knew she had to say sorry. She went to Timmy's house and asked for forgiveness. Timmy forgave her and they became friends again.

From that day on, Lily learned that it's important to do the right thing and to always be kind to others. And whenever she looked at the ornament, she remembered the lesson she had learned about forgiveness.

Once upon a time, there was a box of crayons. The crayons were very organized. They were all in a row, like a rainbow. The crayons liked to color pictures for kids. They were happy when kids used them.

One day, a new crayon came to the box. The new crayon did not have a name. The other crayons wanted to help the new crayon. They all thought of a name for the new crayon. They picked a name that was fun and happy.

The new crayon liked the name. The name was "Sunshine". Sunshine was a pretty yellow color. Now, Sunshine could color pictures with the other crayons. They all had fun together. And the kids loved the pictures they made.

Once upon a time, in a small country, there lived a cheerful girl named Lily. She loved to spend her days playing with her dog, Spot. They would run and jump in the green grass under the bright sun.

One day, Lily and Spot met a boy named Tim. Tim asked, "Do you want to play with me and my cat, Whiskers?" Lily and Spot said, "Yes!" They all played together, laughing and having fun.

But as they played, dark clouds came and covered the sky. It began to rain very hard. Tim, Lily, Spot, and Whiskers got wet and cold. They tried to find a place to hide, but they could not.

Lily said, "I wish the sun would come back." Tim nodded and said, "Me too." They all shivered in the rain, feeling sad. The fun day had turned into a bad day, and they wished they could be warm and dry again.

Once upon a time, there was a frog named Freddy. Freddy lived in a swamp with his friends. One day, Freddy saw a butterfly and wanted to be friends with it. But the butterfly ignored him and flew away. Freddy was upset and didn't know why the butterfly didn't want to be his friend.

Freddy's friends, the other frogs, saw that he was upset and tried to cheer him up. They told him that sometimes people ignore others because they are busy or have other things on their mind. Freddy felt a little better and decided to try again to make friends with the butterfly.

The next day, Freddy saw the butterfly again and this time he didn't feel upset. He hopped over to the butterfly and said hello. The butterfly was surprised but happy to make a new friend. Freddy was happy too and realized that sometimes it's important to not ignore your feelings and try again.

Once upon a time, there was a little town. The people in the town were happy and had lots of yummy food to eat. But one day, a big storm came and broke many things in the town. The houses were broken and the roads were not good anymore. The people were sad because they didn't know how to repair everything.

Then, a little girl came to the town. She saw that everything was broken and she wanted to help. She asked the people if she could repair the houses and the roads. The people were happy and let her do it. She worked hard every day and repaired everything in the town. The people were happy again and thanked the little girl for her help. They gave her lots of yummy food to eat as a reward. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a purple dress that she loved to wear every day. One day, Lily went to the park to play with her friends. She saw a big black dog and wanted to pet it, but her mother told her not to because it might bite her. 

Lily's friend, Timmy, came over and saw the dog too. He wanted to pet it, but his mother also said no. Timmy got mad and said, "I want to pet the dog! I don't care what my mom says!" 

Lily said, "You shouldn't do that, Timmy. If you don't listen to your mom, she might punish you." 

Timmy didn't want to listen to Lily and went to pet the dog anyway. But the dog didn't like it and barked loudly. Timmy got scared and ran away. Lily's mom came over and said, "See, Timmy got scared because he didn't listen. It's important to listen to your parents so you don't get hurt." 

Lily nodded and said, "I'm glad I listened. I don't want to get punished or hurt."

Once upon a time, there was a kind boy named Tim. Tim had a pet parrot. The parrot was very pretty. It had many colors.

One day, the parrot saw a sad cat. The cat did not have a home. The parrot was compassionate. It wanted to help the cat. The parrot told Tim about the cat.

Tim went to the cat. He gave the cat a home. The cat was happy. The parrot was happy too. They all played together and had a lot of fun.

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. She loved playing in the park and was always looking for something new to explore. One day, when she was playing in the park, she found a brightly coloured pastel. It was so pretty, she wanted to take it home with her. She quickly ran home and showed her mummy the pastel. Her mummy was embarrassed but said it was okay to take it home. 

Daisy was so excited about her new pastel, she snuggled up with it and fell asleep. She had the most amazing dream about the pastel, playing with it in a beautiful garden full of colourful flowers and birds. When she woke up, the dream felt so real. Daisy held the pastel close and was happy to have found it in the park.

Once upon a time there was a young fish named Jake. Jake loved to explore the reef. He would swim around it every day and explore all of its nooks and crannies. 

One day, as he was exploring, he noticed something odd. He said to himself, "Where did all the coral go?". He looked around but he couldn't find it anywhere. 

Suddenly, he saw a magical bubble floating towards him. When it came close, it vanished! Jake gasped. He knew that he had to act fast if he wanted to see where it went. 

He jumped into the water and started swimming. He followed the bubble until it stopped at the edge of a cliff. Looking down he saw something strange- a secret hidden cave with glimmering objects inside it!

Jake curiously peered inside and saw a large collection of coral. He was amazed! He quickly swam down to retrieve the coral before it could vanish again! He was able to save the reef and protect all of the young fish living there.

Jake was proud of himself for saving the reef. He swam back to his home, with a big smile on his face.

Once there was a little seal that was very hungry. He had been looking for food for a long time, but he just couldn't find anything to eat.

The seal swam and swam, but he was still very hungry. Then he saw an ice cream cone. He swam up to it and tried to grab it, but he lost it and it fell into the ocean. 

He was so sad that he started to cry. He was so hungry and he wanted the ice cream cone so badly. But he had lost it. 

Just then, he saw a crab. The crab said he was feeling generous and wanted to help the seal. He gave the seal a big fish to eat. The seal was so happy, he gobbled up the fish right away!

The little seal was so happy he had something to eat at last. He thanked the kind crab and swam away, no longer hungry.

Lily was a little girl who liked to play with her toys. She had a big doll, a red car, a yellow ball and a blue bear. She loved her toys very much and took good care of them. She always put them away in her box when she was done playing.

One day, Lily was playing with her toys in her room. She heard a loud noise outside. She ran to the window and saw a big truck. The truck was very dirty and noisy. It had a big shovel on the front. Lily was curious and scared. She wondered what the truck was doing.

She saw the truck move closer to her house. She saw the shovel lift up and hit the wall. She heard a crash and saw bricks fall down. She screamed and ran to the door. She wanted to find her mom and dad. But the door was stuck. She could not open it. She was trapped in her room.

She looked around and saw her toys. They were scattered on the floor. Some of them were broken. She saw her big doll with a missing arm. She saw her red car with a smashed wheel. She saw her yellow ball with a hole. She saw her blue bear with a ripped ear. She felt sad and angry. She wanted her toys back. She wanted to get out of her room.

She heard another loud noise. She saw the shovel hit the wall again. She saw a big hole appear in the wall. She saw the truck driver's face. He had a big nose and a mean smile. He saw Lily and laughed. He said, "Hello, little girl. Do you want to play with me?" He reached his hand through the hole and grabbed Lily's hair. He pulled her towards the hole. Lily felt pain and fear. She tried to scream and kick. But she was helpless. She could not stop him. He took her out of her room and threw her in the back of his truck. He drove away with her. Lily never saw her mom and dad or her toys again.

One day, a stubborn little girl and her mom went to the beach. The girl wanted to buy a reef. Her mom said, "No, we can't buy a reef." But the little girl was very stubborn and didn't listen. She kept asking her mom to buy a reef. Finally, her mom agreed to help her buy a reef. They walked to the store together. The mom bought a big, beautiful reef for the girl. The girl was so happy. She thanked her mom and ran back to the beach. When she got there, she waved the reef in the air and shouted for joy. She had her new reef and couldn't be happier.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she found a funny hat that made her giggle. She put it on and ran around shouting, "Look at me!" Her friends thought the hat was funny too and they all laughed and played together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Lily. She loved to cook with her mom in the kitchen. One day, they decided to make a colorful cake for Lily's birthday. They mixed all the ingredients together and put it in the oven to bake. 

While they waited, Lily's mom asked her what she wanted for her birthday. Lily said she wanted a puppy. Her mom said they would have to wait until they had more money. 

Suddenly, the oven started to smoke and the cake burned. Lily's mom was upset, but Lily didn't mind. She said, "It's okay, Mommy. We can still have fun on my birthday." 

But when Lily woke up on her birthday, there was no cake and no puppy. She was sad and cried. Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. We'll try again next year."

Once upon a time, there was a little baby named Timmy. Timmy loved to crawl around on the floor and explore. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a tasty cookie to eat. Timmy loved the cookie so much that he wanted to eat it all at once, but his mom had a question for him. "Timmy, do you want to share your cookie with me?" she asked. Timmy thought about it for a moment and then gave his mom a big smile and offered her a piece of his tasty cookie.

Once upon a time, there was a playful puppy named Max. Max loved to run and play in the park with his friends. One day, Max saw an ambulance go by with its loud siren. Max wondered where it was going.

Max followed the ambulance and saw that it stopped at his friend's house. Max's friend had hurt his leg and needed help. Max felt sad for his friend and wanted to help too.

Max barked and wagged his tail to show the ambulance people that he wanted to help. The ambulance people saw how playful and friendly Max was and let him come along. Max helped cheer up his friend on the way to the hospital. Max felt happy that he could help his friend feel better.

Lily was a little girl who liked to sing. She had a case with many songs inside. She sang every day and wanted to improve her voice. She dreamed of being a powerful singer who could make people happy.

One day, she met a boy named Ben who also liked to sing. He had a case with many instruments inside. He played every day and wanted to improve his skills. He dreamed of being a powerful musician who could make people dance.

"Hello, I am Lily. I like your case. What do you have inside?" Lily asked Ben.

"Hello, I am Ben. I like your case too. What do you sing?" Ben asked Lily.

"I sing many songs. I like songs that are happy and fun. Do you want to hear one?" Lily said.

"Yes, I do. I play many instruments. I like instruments that are loud and cool. Do you want to see one?" Ben said.

They opened their cases and showed each other their songs and instruments. They decided to try to sing and play together. They had a lot of fun and learned from each other. They improved their voice and skills. They became powerful friends who could make music.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars and trucks. One day, he wanted to play with his red truck, but he couldn't find it.

"Mommy, where is my red truck?" Timmy asked.

"I don't know, Timmy. Did you put it away in your toy box?" his mom replied.

Timmy looked in his toy box, but his red truck wasn't there. He looked all over his room, but he still couldn't find it. Suddenly, he remembered that he had put it in his toy chest.

"I remember, Mommy! I put it in my toy chest, but I can't unlock it. Can you help me?" Timmy asked.

His mom went to the toy chest and saw that the number on the lock was not clear. She cleaned it with a cloth and then unlocked the chest. Timmy was so happy to find his red truck and he played with it all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little robot. The robot was very tired because it had been working all day. It wanted to rest and recharge its batteries. So, the robot went to its charging station and plugged itself in.

However, while the robot was resting, a little girl came into the room. She didn't see the robot and accidentally slipped on some toys on the floor. The girl fell and hit the charging station, making the robot fall down too.

The robot was very upset because it had been knocked over. It was also worried that its batteries might have been damaged. But the little girl quickly apologized and helped the robot back up. The robot realized that accidents happen and it was happy to see that the little girl was okay. From that day on, the robot and the little girl became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wander around her backyard and explore. One day, she found a funny-looking plant with prickly needles. It was a cactus! Lily was very careful not to touch it.

Soon, her friends came over to play. They decided to have a race to see who could run the fastest. Lily was very competitive and wanted to win. But as they ran, she accidentally tripped and fell into the cactus! Ouch!

Lily's mom came to help her and carefully removed the needles. From then on, Lily learned to be more careful when she wandered around outside. And she realized that winning isn't everything - having fun with friends is more important.

Once upon a time, there was a mouse who was very tight. Every day, the mouse would look for food, but all the food was gone.

One day, the mouse heard a loud ring. The mouse followed the sound and found a big bell with a string attached. The mouse tugged on the string and the bell rang again. 

The mouse was so excited and tugged on the string again and again. He kept pulling the string until it was very tight. Suddenly, the mouse heard a noise from a nearby bush.

To the mouse's surprise, a bucket of food had been revealed! The mouse jumped for joy and filled his tummy with food.

The mouse was so happy that he had found food, that he ran off and sang a cheerful song. He was glad he had followed the ringing bell because it led him to the yummy food. 

The End.

Once there was a little boy, named Jimmy. He was three years old and loved to go on adventures. One day, Jimmy was in the park playing with his friends. He found a passport laying on the ground and eagerly picked it up. When he opened it he noticed it was wet.

Suddenly, his mommy screamed. "Jimmy, that's not yours! Quickly put it back!" Jimmy quickly put the passport back on the ground and ran to his mommy. 

His mommy said, â€œThat passport is a very important item. People use passports to travel to different places. You must never pick something up that is not yours.â€ 

Jimmy said, â€œOkay mommy, I'm sorry.â€ His mommy hugged him and said, â€œIt's alright, just be more careful next time.â€ 

Jimmy nodded, and he and his mommy continued exploring the park.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play outside. They had an aunt who was adventurous. She liked to travel and see new things. Sometimes she sent them postcards from far away places.

One day, their aunt came to visit them. She brought them a big suitcase full of gifts. She said, "I have something for each of you. But you have to guess what it is."

Lily and Ben were excited. They opened the suitcase and saw many things. There were books, toys, clothes, and more. They started to grab and pull the things they liked.

"Stop!" their aunt said. "You have to share and take turns. And you have to be careful. Some of these things are fragile or special. They are not for playing. They are for learning and remembering."

Lily and Ben did not listen. They wanted to have everything. They did not care about the other things. They did not care about their aunt. They fought and argued and made a mess.

Their aunt was sad and angry. She said, "You are being selfish and rude. You do not appreciate what I brought you. You do not respect me or my stories. You are not ready for these gifts. You have to learn to be grateful and curious and kind."

She took the suitcase and closed it. She said, "I will keep these gifts until you grow up. Maybe then you will understand their value. Maybe then you will want to be adventurous like me."

She left the room and went to talk to their mom. Lily and Ben remained in the room. They looked at each other and felt ashamed. They realized they had made a mistake. They wished they had listened to their aunt. They wished they had asked her about the things and the places. They wished they had been more adventurous.

Moral: Be grateful for what you have and curious about what you don't. Respect and learn from others who are different from you. Be adventurous and open-minded.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Amy and Ben. They were walking in the woods when they saw something shiny. 

Amy said, â€œLetâ€™s go see what it is!â€

The monster growled, â€œYou need to give me the piece!â€
