Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo was very curious and always wanted to explore the ocean. One day, Nemo saw a big shark swimming towards him. Nemo was scared and didn't know what to do. 

The shark saw that Nemo was scared and asked him why. Nemo explained that he was scared of sharks because he heard they were mean. The shark smiled and said, "Don't be scared of me. I'm a smart shark and I know that being mean doesn't make friends." 

Nemo was surprised and thanked the shark for being kind. From that day on, Nemo and the shark became friends and explored the ocean together. Nemo learned that not all sharks are mean and that it's important to not judge someone before you get to know them.

Anna and Ben are playing with blocks. They like to make towers and houses with the blocks. They have many blocks of different colors and shapes. Some blocks have numbers on them.

"Look, Ben, I have a block with the number six!" Anna says, holding up a yellow block.

"Wow, that is a big number!" Ben says. "I have a block with the number four. It is blue."

They put their blocks together and make a big tower. They are happy and proud of their tower.

"Can we find more blocks with numbers?" Anna asks.

"Let's search!" Ben says.

They look around the room and search for more blocks with numbers. They find a block with the number one, a block with the number two, and a block with the number three. They add them to their tower.

"Look, we have all the numbers from one to six!" Anna says.

"That is amazing!" Ben says.

They search for more blocks with numbers, but they cannot find any. They look under the table, behind the sofa, and in the toy box. But all the blocks are empty. They have no numbers on them.

"Where are the other numbers?" Anna asks.

"I don't know," Ben says. "Maybe they are hiding."

They are sad and confused. They want to find more numbers.

"Maybe we can ask Mommy," Anna says.

"Maybe she knows," Ben says.

They leave their tower and go to find Mommy. They hope she can help them find more numbers. They like numbers. They are fun and smart.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl named Lily. She loved to explore the big, green park near her house. One day, while she was walking, she found a patch of colorful flowers. She picked some of them and took them home.

Lily's mommy saw the flowers and asked her where she got them. Lily told her about the patch she found in the park. Her mommy was curious too, so they went back to the park together.

While they were there, they saw a happy couple getting married under a big tree. Lily thought it was so beautiful and she wished to get married one day too. Her mommy smiled and said, "Maybe one day you will, Lily."

Once upon a time, there was a special girl. Her name was Jane, and she was very curious. One day, Jane decided to try something new. She wanted to touch yoga.

So, Jane got dressed and went to the yoga studio. She was very excited to stretch and exercise. She could barely wait to try the original yoga moves.

When she got there, Jane saw lots of people in funny poses. She laughed and tried to copy them. Everyone around her smiled and clapped.

Jane was so proud that she had learnt something new. She laughed and thanked everyone for helping her with her yoga moves. Jane was so proud of herself for touching yoga in the most original way.

Sara loves flowers. She likes to look at them and smell them. She has a small garden with many flowers. She waters them every day and talks to them.

One day, she sees a new flower in her garden. It is bright yellow and has many petals. Sara is happy. She runs to the flower and says, "Hello, flower! You are so pretty! What is your name?"

The flower does not answer. Sara thinks maybe the flower is shy. She says, "Don't be afraid, flower. I am Sara. I care for you. I will give you water and sun. You can be my friend."

The flower still does not answer. Sara is sad. She thinks maybe the flower does not like her. She says, "Please, flower, talk to me. I want to hear your voice. Do you like me?"

The flower still does not answer. Sara is about to cry. She thinks maybe the flower is sick. She says, "Are you okay, flower? Do you need something? I will help you."

Then, she hears a small voice. It is the flower. The flower says, "Hello, Sara. I am sorry I did not talk to you. I was asleep. I am a sunflower. I only wake up when the sun is bright. Thank you for caring for me. You are very kind. I like you."

Sara is happy. She smiles and hugs the flower. She says, "I am glad you are awake, sunflower. You are very beautiful. I am happy to be your friend."

The flower smiles and nods. It says, "I am happy to be your friend, too, Sara. You make me feel warm and loved. Let's talk and play together."

Sara and the sunflower become good friends. They talk and play every day. They care for each other and make each other happy. They are the brightest flowers in the garden.

Once upon a time, in the summer, there was a boy named Tim. Tim liked to watch the birds fly in the sky. He also liked to watch the flowers grow in his garden. Tim's house was very modern and had lots of big windows to watch things from inside.

One day, Tim went on a walk with his mom. They saw lots of pretty flowers and watched the butterflies fly around them. They also saw a big, modern building with lots of people inside. Tim thought it was very cool to watch all the people going in and out of the building.

After their walk, Tim and his mom went to the park. They watched the kids playing on the swings and the slide. Tim had so much fun watching everything that he didn't even notice when it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was an old shelf in a house. The shelf was very big and it had many things on it. One day, something bad happened. The shelf fell down and all the things on it broke into small pieces. The old shelf was broken too and it could not be fixed. The people in the house were very sad because they lost all their things. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a shy monkey who loved bananas. Whenever he saw a banana, he would reach out and grab it. One day, as he was walking through the jungle, he saw a very ripe banana. He went to grab it but it wouldn't budge. He had to resist the urge to grab it. 

He looked around and saw that there was a crocodile standing guard over the banana. He was scared and tried to walk away quickly. The crocodile noticed and started to chase him! 

The monkey ran and ran, but the crocodile was getting closer. He had to think of something to get away! Suddenly, he remembered the banana. He quickly grabbed the banana in his hand and ran away from the crocodile. 

The monkey was safe and happy. He happily ate the banana and thought about how much he had resisted to get it!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends were playing hide-and-seek when they saw a scary mask on the ground. Timmy's friends thought it was funny and put the mask on, but Timmy didn't like it. He felt scared and wanted to go home.

As they were walking home, they heard a loud noise. Timmy's friends started to panic and run away, but Timmy stayed calm and honest. He saw that the noise was just a big truck passing by. Timmy's friends were happy that they were safe, and they thanked Timmy for being brave.

From that day on, Timmy's friends knew that he was always honest and brave, even when things got scary. They never played with scary masks again, and Timmy was happy to be able to play with his friends without feeling scared.

It was a beautiful day, and the air was filled with sunshine and birdsong. Joe was playing in the park with Molly, his best friend.

"Let's pretend to sail!" shouted Molly, pointing to the pond.

Joe smiled, and they both ran to the edge of the water. Joe grabbed a stick, while Molly scooped up some leaves and stones.

"We can make them into a boat!" Molly said, giving Joe a leaf.

Joe made a boat shape with his stick and leaf, while Molly made a boat with her stones. When they were done, they put them carefully in the water and watched.

"Will they float?" asked Joe.

Molly smiled and nodded. "You just have to be patient."

The two friends sat and watched as the boats slowly sailed away from the pond. Joe and Molly laughed as the boats sailed back and forth.

At last, the two friends stood up. "It was fun sailing!" said Joe.

Molly agreed. "Let's do it again some time."

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a boy named Tom. Tom was a happy boy who liked to play all day. One day, Tom met a new friend, Sam. They decided to play outside together.

As they played, Tom said, "Sam, tomorrow is an important day. We will have a big party in the park." Sam was excited and said, "I can't wait for the party, Tom!"

The next day, the sun shone brightly as the party began. Tom and Sam played games and ate yummy food. Suddenly, the wind began to blow hard, and it started to rain. Tom and Sam ran under a tree for shelter. Tom said, "Don't worry, Sam. We can still have fun."

They played under the tree until the rain stopped. When the sun came out again, they continued to enjoy the important day. Tom and Sam were very happy they could still have fun, even when the rain tried to ruin their day. They knew they would always remember this special day.

Alice and Lenny were in the park when they heard splashing. They ran over to the pond and saw a mole swimming. It was having trouble swimming, so Lenny decided to dive in and help the mole.

Lenny: "Don't worry, little mole. I'll help you."

He quickly dove into the water and grabbed the mole. He pulled the troubled mole to safety. Alice laughed and gave Lenny a big hug.

Alice: "You're so brave, Lenny!"

Lenny smiled and looked at the mole.

Lenny: "Do you want to come and play with us?"

The mole shook its head and ran off through the grass. Alice and Lenny laughed and went back to their game.

Once upon a time, there was a modest girl named Lucy. She was preparing for a very special day â€“ a day to celebrate a delicious dinner!

The dinner was a special cauliflower dish that Lucy had never seen before. It was white, bumpy and smelled like something yummy!

Lucy was so excited that she couldn't wait to tell her family about it. She ran to find her mom and dad and shouted, â€œLook what I found - a special, bumpy cauliflower! We can all celebrate the dinner together!â€

Her family was just as excited as she was. They all worked together to prepare the delicious dinner.

When the meal was ready, they all sat down to enjoy it. It was a joyful feast, shared by the little family with love. Everyone had a wonderful time celebrating the special dinner.

The end.

Molly was so excited! Her mum had just told her that she was getting a box of toys today. She jumped up and down, clapping her hands and shouting "Yay!"

When the box arrived, Molly's dad helped her to unpack it. Inside, there were all kinds of amazing toys. There was a hopscotch set, a big top hat and a crazy spinning top.

Molly loved them all, and she couldn't decide which one to play with first. Then a voice said "I think you should play with this one". Molly looked around, but no one else was in the room. She slowly turned her gaze to the box, and saw the little blue spinning top smiling at her.

Molly gasped and said "Oh, hello! Are you a talking toy?". The spinning top nodded and said "Yes, of course I am! Why don't you play with me first?".

Molly was so excited to be playing with a talking toy that she couldn't wait to start. She grabbed the spinning top, and the two of them had a crazy, fun-filled day, full of spinning, laughing and playing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the fields near her house. One day, she found a big bag of corn lying on the ground. She picked it up and took it home.

Her mommy cooked the corn for dinner that night. It was very mild and tasty. Lily smiled as she ate it all up. After dinner, she went to bed feeling very happy.

The next day, Lily woke up and went outside to play again. She saw a scarecrow in the field and decided to go say hello. As she got closer, she saw that the scarecrow was wearing the same shirt as her daddy! She smiled and ran back to the house to tell her mommy.

Later that day, her daddy came home and they all went outside to see the scarecrow. Lily's daddy was surprised to see his shirt on the scarecrow. He smiled and laughed, realizing that he must have left it in the field when he was helping with the corn harvest. From then on, they always checked the scarecrow for any lost items before leaving the field.

Once upon a time, there was a family of bears who lived in the woods. They were a unique family because they all had different colored fur. Mama bear had brown fur, Papa bear had black fur, and Baby bear had white fur.

One day, Mama bear decided to make some delicious porridge for breakfast. She cooked it in three different bowls, one for each bear. But the porridge was too hot, so the bears went for a walk in the woods while it cooled down.

As they walked, they met a little girl named Goldilocks. She was lost and hungry, so the bears invited her to try their porridge. Baby bear's porridge was just right for her, so she ate it all up.

But when the bears came back, they saw that someone had been in their house. Mama bear noticed that her porridge had been tasted, Papa bear saw that his chair had been sat on, and Baby bear saw that his bed had been slept in. Suddenly, they heard a noise in Baby bear's room.

"Who's there?" asked Papa bear.

"It's me, Goldilocks," said the little girl. "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to bite your porridge."

The bears forgave Goldilocks and they all became friends. From that day on, they had many adventures together in the woods.

Once upon a time, there lived two animals. The first animal was a small, round rabbit. The second animal was a big, strong bear. The rabbit and the bear lived far apart in two different forests. 

The rabbit wanted to find someone to play with, so he looked for the bear. He found a plant that was growing in the forest and he knew it was special. It was an herb that made the rabbit and the bear feel like friends. 

One day, the rabbit decided to take the herb with him on his journey. When he came close to the bearâ€™s home, the rabbit gave the herb to the bear. As soon as the bear ate it, he and the rabbit felt like old friends!

The bear and the rabbit decided to join together and explore the different forests. They became best friends, and their friendship was made heavier with every new adventure. 

And that is the story of how the rabbit and the bear united together with the help of a special herb!

Tom and Lily were playing in the snow. They made a big snowman with a hat, a scarf and a carrot for a nose. They were very happy.

"Look, our snowman is so nice!" Lily said.

"Yes, he is. But he needs something else. He needs eyes and a mouth," Tom said.

They looked around for some stones or sticks. They saw a big red car arrive. A man got out of the car. He had a big red nose and a big red smile.

"Hello, children. I am Mr. Claus. I have some presents for you," he said.

Tom and Lily were surprised and excited. They ran to the car.

"Wow, thank you, Mr. Claus. You are so kind," they said.

Mr. Claus gave them a big bag of toys. They opened the bag and saw dolls, cars, books and games. They hugged Mr. Claus.

"Thank you, thank you, thank you," they said.

Mr. Claus laughed. He touched his red nose.

"You are very welcome, children. But I have to go now. I have more presents to deliver. Merry Christmas," he said.

He got back in his car and drove away. Tom and Lily waved goodbye.

They looked at their snowman. He had a big red nose and a big red smile, just like Mr. Claus.

They smiled too. They had the best Christmas ever.

Once upon a time, there was a big family. They loved to play and laugh together. One day, they went on a picnic. The sun was shining and the birds were singing. The family brought a special drink to share. It was called lemonade. The lemonade tasted unique, like nothing they had ever tried before. They all drank it and smiled. They were happy to be together as a family.

Lily and Max liked to play with chalk. They drew big pictures on the sidewalk. They made flowers, stars, and cars. They used many colors. They were happy.

But then, a big dog came. The dog was brown and furry. He barked loud. He ran fast. He saw the chalk pictures. He wanted to play too. He jumped on the sidewalk. He scratched the pictures with his paws. He destroyed the chalk.

Lily and Max were sad. They cried. They said, "Go away, dog! You are bad! You ruined our pictures!"

The dog did not understand. He thought they were playing. He licked their faces. He wagged his tail. He wanted to be friends.

Lily and Max stopped crying. They looked at the dog. He was cute. He was sweet. They petted him. They said, "OK, dog. You can stay. But you have to be nice. You can't destroy our chalk."

The dog nodded. He barked softly. He was sorry. He wanted to be nice. He helped them draw new pictures. He made a heart, a bone, and a dog. He used his nose. He was happy. Lily and Max were happy too. They played with chalk and the dog. They had fun. The end.

One day, Lola was smiling as she sat at the piano. She had been learning to play it for a couple of months. Lola had been wanting to play the piano since she saw Mama play it one day. Mama always smiled so much when she was playing the piano.

Suddenly, Lola heard Mama's voice coming from the other room. "Come quick, Lola. You must see something," Mama said. Lola ran down the hallway to find Mama looking at an old black piano. "It's for you, Lola," Mama said. Lola was so excited that she started smiling even bigger than before.

However, when Lola tried to play the black piano, it was not as easy as it was with the other piano. She felt so frustrated that she wanted to cry. Mama said, "It's okay, Lola. You just need practice and soon you will be able to play it just as good as you can play the other piano."

So Lola practiced for some days and the black piano started to sound better. She smiled as she played and soon it sounded just as good as the other piano.

Mama came by to listen to Lola and smiled proudly. "I knew you could do it, Lola," Mama said. Lola smiled and continued to play the black piano, feeling happy and proud.

One day, Sally wanted to do something special. She thought and thought and then had an idea. She went outside to the field. It was lovely. The sun was shining, the flowers were blooming, and the birds were singing. Sally wandered around the field and enjoyed the beauty of nature.

Then she had an even better idea. She found some sticks and gathered them up. She arranged them in a circle and then began to do something special. She decorated the sticks with brightly coloured petals and made a beautiful flower. She smiled at her creation and admired it in the sunshine.

Then Sally lay in the grass and felt how lucky she was. From her spot she could see all the lovely things in the field. She was filled with love for all the things in nature. She watched the clouds and the birds and felt so happy that she was alive.

Once upon a time there was a girl. Her hair was very long and she had fun brushing it. One day she wanted to do something special with it. She went to her mom and asked for help. Mom smiled and took her into the bedroom. Mom showed her the big box of bows and ribbons. The girl had so many to choose from! Her mom picked a pretty one and started to wrap it in the girl's hair. She pulled it tight and tied it with a knot. The girl was so happy! 

The girl ran to show her dad. He smiled when he saw her, and said her hair looked great! Dad asked if she wanted to go outside. She said yes and they went to the park. It was so loud outside with all the children playing. She ran around and laughed, her hair bow bouncing in the wind. She felt so happy that she had made her hair so pretty.

The girl went back to her mom and asked to wrap her hair again. Mom said that was a great idea! So the girl and her mom spent the afternoon wrapping her hair and tying pretty bows. She felt like a princess and was so proud of how she had made her hair look.

Once upon a time, there was a bright sun in the sky. The sun made everything look happy and fun. Under a big tree, a little boy named Tim was playing with his toys. He liked to play outside when the sun was shining.

One day, Tim found a big rock. He thought a monster might lie under it. He was scared but wanted to see the monster. So, he pushed the rock very hard. But there was no monster, only a small bug. Tim was happy it was not a monster.

From that day on, Tim was not scared of monsters anymore. He played outside with his toys under the bright sun every day. And sometimes, he even looked under rocks to find new friends like the small bug.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy was playing with his toy hammer, but he realized that he needed a real tool to fix his broken toy. 

Timmy went to his dad and asked him for a tool. His dad gave him a real hammer and Timmy was so happy! He fixed his broken toy and it was like new again. 

Timmy thought it was funny how a real tool could fix things so easily. He decided that he wanted to be a builder when he grew up so he could fix things all the time. From that day on, Timmy played with his tools and fixed all his broken toys.

Lily was out at the park with her parents on a sunny day. Her daddy was throwing a frisbee for her to catch. Suddenly, he shouted "Lily, look up!" She looked up, and saw a large bird with a gray body flying above her. It had a big heart on its chest.

Lily exclaimed "Look, Mommy! What is it?" Her mother replied "It is a lovebird. It is very rare!" Lily said "I want it!"

Lily's father then said "Don't worry, I won't let it get away. Get ready!" He took out a gun and shot the air. The lovebird flew away, scared.

Lily was sad and started to cry. She said "I wanted the bird! I wanted to keep it!" Her mother said "Sometimes, it is better to let things go. It is for their own good"

Lily understood and said "I won't make the same mistake again. I know now the best thing to do is to help my friends fly!" Lily's happy parents hugged her in joy. They were happy that Lily had learned a valuable lesson.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a letter on the floor. He picked it up and looked at it. He could not read, so he asked his intelligent big sister, Jane, to help him.

Jane read the letter out loud. "Dear Tim, I am your friend, Mr. Cat. I lost my toy. Can you find it? Love, Mr. Cat." Tim wanted to help his friend, so he and Jane looked everywhere for the toy.

They looked under the bed, behind the door, and even in the garden. Finally, they found the toy in a tree. Tim was so happy, he screamed, "We found it, Jane!" They gave the toy back to Mr. Cat, and he was very thankful.

Once upon a time, there was a normal mole. The mole lived in a hole in the ground. He had many friends, like a bird, a cat, and a dog.

One day, the mole found a big, shiny rock. He did not know what it was, but he thought it was pretty. The mole showed the rock to his friends. They all liked it too.

The mole and his friends learned to value the shiny rock. They played with it every day. The shiny rock made them all very happy. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, Tom went for a walk in the park. He saw a large lumber appear from far away. It was very flexible and Tom wanted to explore it. He touched the lumber and it moved left and right. He had so much fun! He ran around it, jumped over it, and crawled under it. He spent the whole day playing with the flexible lumber. After a while, Tom's mother called him over for dinner. But the next day, when Tom came back, the lumber had disappeared.

Once upon a time, there was an egg. It was a big egg and it was frightened. Every day it sat in its nest worrying.

One day, a big bird came along. It wanted to pay the egg with some food. At first, the egg was still frightened, but it felt hungry too. So, it slowly decided to take the food. 

The bird paid the egg every day with food. The egg ate a lot and became strong and brave. It even became friends with the bird.

The egg was no longer frightened. It felt brave and happy. And together, the egg and the bird lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim who went fishing with his dad. The little boy had never seen an oyster before and was very excited. When Tim and his dad got to the beach, they found a big oyster tucked under a rock. 

"Dad," Tim said, "can I try to break open the oyster?" 

His dad smiled. "Sure," he said. "But be careful!" 

Tim carefully picked up the oyster and tried to break it open with a rock. He was so excited when he finally saw the original pearl inside. 

"Amazing!" Tim said. 

He showed the pearl to his dad who smiled. Together they put the pearl back into the oyster, put it back in the sea, and went back home. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a cat. He was gentle and loved to play. One day, he decided to go for a walk. He walked and he walked until he came across an old tree. Inside the tree he found a jar of jam. He was so happy! He put the jam in his pocket and continued walking until it was time to go home.

On the way back, he heard a noise. He turned around and saw a little bird. The bird was scared so the cat was very gentle. He moved slowly and spoke softly to the bird. The bird decided to come with him and they began to walk back together.

They arrived home and the cat set the jar of jam down on the table. He remembered the bird and said goodbye. The bird thanked him and flew away.

The cat thought about the bird all night and the next day he decided to return to the old tree. He looked everywhere but the bird was nowhere to be seen. He left some of the jam for the bird and then he gently walked back home.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She loved playing in her room. Jane was always so tidy and neat.

One day, Jane wanted to try something new. She took out a small book from her shelf and saw that it was full of funny words. She was excited to learn how to spell them. She started to practice each word very carefully.

Whenever she got stuck, she would pause and think about the sound of each letter. After a while, she was able to spell some of the words correctly. Jane was so proud of her progress.

As the days went by, Jane got better and better at her spelling. She was so happy that she had learnt such a new and exciting skill!

The moral of the story is that when you practice hard, you get better at anything you do.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Holly. Holly was only three years old, but she was very brave. She lived in a big house with her mom and dad.

One day, Holly wanted to explore the house. She wanted to see what was inside. So, she opened the door in the front room. In front of her, was a long cable. Holly was very curious. She wanted to touch the cable, but it was too high.

Holly's mom heard her from the other room. Mom knew what Holly wanted. She had to do something. So, she found a big box and put the cable in it. She put the box on the floor to make it easier for Holly.

Holly was so excited! She grabbed the cable and started playing with it. The cable was very soft and comfortable. She hugged it and stayed with it all day. From that day on, Holly always opened the box to play with her special cable.

Once upon a time, in a far away land, there lived a little boy called John. He lived in a castle and he was very curious and loved to explore. One day, he decided to explore a mysterious forest nearby. 

As he walked, he saw something sparkling on the ground. It was a bottle containing a special glue. He picked it up and opened it. When he did, something magical began to happen.

The glue started to grow and grow. Soon it began to rise up off the ground, and it kept going, until it was as tall as a giant tree. John discovered that the glue could make anything he wanted, so he asked it to build him a treehouse. 

The glue began to build a treehouse right before his eyes. It rose higher and higher and before he knew it, he had a beautiful treehouse to play in. John was overjoyed and enjoyed playing in his mysterious treehouse every day. 

The end.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play in the garden. They have a big box. They pretend it is a house. They draw windows and a door on the box.

One day, they see a post in the garden. It is brown and long. It has a red flag on top. Sara says, "Look, Ben, a post! Maybe it has a letter for us!" Ben says, "Let's go and see!" They run to the post.

They open the post. It has a letter for them. It is from Grandma. They love Grandma. She lives far away. She sends them gifts and sweets. They open the letter. It says, "Dear Sara and Ben, I miss you very much. I hope you are happy and healthy. I have a surprise for you. I made you some cookies. They are in the post. They are yummy. Enjoy them. Love, Grandma."

Sara and Ben are very happy. They love cookies. They look in the post. They see a bag. It has cookies in it. They smell good. They take one each. They say, "Thank you, Grandma!" They bite the cookies.

But the cookies are not yummy. They are yucky. They taste bad. They taste like dirt and worms. Sara and Ben spit out the cookies. They make a face. They say, "Ew, ew, ew!" They feel sick. They feel sad.

They look at the letter again. They see something they did not see before. It says, "P.S. April Fools!" They do not know what that means. They do not think it is funny. They think Grandma is mean. They cry. They do not want to play anymore. They go inside the box. They close the door. They do not want to see the post ever again.

Once upon a time, a little dog named Bobo loved to play in the mud. One day, Bobo played in the mud for a very long time. He got very dirty. His fur was all brown and sticky. Bobo's mom saw him and knew it was time for a bath.

Bobo did not like to take a bath. He did not want to be clean. He wanted to play in the mud some more. But his mom said, "No, Bobo, you must bathe now." Bobo was sad and did not want to listen. He tried to run away, but his mom caught him.

Bobo's mom put him in the bath. She washed him with soap and warm water. At first, Bobo was not happy. But then, he started to feel good. The warm water made him feel nice. When the bath was over, Bobo was clean and his fur was soft. He was grateful to his mom for the bath. Now, Bobo liked to play in the mud and take baths too.

Once upon a time there was an ant. He was walking through the woods and he came to a meadow. In the meadow, he saw something delicious. It was a cookie! The ant was so happy and he wanted to stay and eat the cookie.

The ant looked around to make sure no one was watching. Then he quickly grabbed the cookie and started to eat it. He was so happy and it was so delicious. He kept eating until he finished the whole thing. 

When the ant was done, he was full. He was so happy that he stayed in the meadow and started to look for more delicious things to eat. And that is the story of the ant who found a delicious cookie.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and eat yummy food. But sometimes they fight over things. One day, Mom made sausages for lunch. She gave Lily and Ben one sausage each on a plate.

"Wow, sausages!" Lily said. "I love sausages!"

"Me too!" Ben said. "They smell good!"

They both took a big bite of their sausages. They were hot and juicy. But then Lily saw something on Ben's plate. It was a piece of cheese. Lily liked cheese too. She wanted some.

"Ben, can I have some cheese?" Lily asked.

"No, it's mine!" Ben said. "You have a sausage!"

"But I want cheese too!" Lily said. "Please, Ben, share with me!"

Ben shook his head. He did not want to share his cheese. He liked it too much. He put it in his mouth and chewed. Lily felt sad and angry. She did not think it was fair.

"Mom, Ben won't share his cheese with me!" Lily cried.

Mom heard Lily and came to the table. She saw Lily's tears and Ben's cheese. She knew it was difficult for them to share sometimes. But she wanted them to be kind to each other.

"Lily, Ben, sharing is a good thing to do," Mom said. "It makes you and others happy. How would you feel if Ben wanted some of your sausage and you said no?"

Lily thought for a moment. She knew she would not like it if Ben took her sausage. She would feel sad and angry too. She looked at Ben and saw that he had finished his cheese. He looked happy.

"Maybe I can share my sausage with Ben," Lily said. "Then we can both have some sausage and cheese."

Ben heard Lily and smiled. He liked the idea of having some sausage too. He felt sorry for making Lily cry. He wanted to be nice to her.

"Thank you, Lily," Ben said. "That's very kind of you. I'm sorry I didn't share my cheese with you. Next time I will."

Lily and Ben hugged each other. They cut their sausages in half and swapped. They ate their lunch happily. Mom was proud of them. She gave them a kiss and a hug.

"Good job, Lily and Ben," Mom said. "You learned how to share. Sharing is caring. I love you both very much."

Once upon a time, there was a big bear. He had a big case that he carried with him everywhere he went. One day, the bear met a little rabbit. The rabbit asked the bear what was in the big case. The bear didn't know how to answer, so he just shrugged his shoulders. 

The rabbit was curious and asked the bear if he could see what was inside the big case. The bear thought for a moment and then opened the case. Inside, there was a big surprise! It was a bunch of colorful balloons! The rabbit was so excited and asked the bear if he could have one. 

The bear was happy to share and gave the rabbit a big red balloon. The rabbit was so happy that he started to jump up and down. The bear smiled and shrugged his shoulders again, happy to have made a new friend. From that day on, the bear and the rabbit went on many big adventures together with the big case full of balloons.

Once, there was a little boy in a distant place. His name was Joe. Joe was very lonely and one day his chest started to feel very heavy inside. He noticed he was feeling sad and started to weep. Joe wept and wept until night time and he was still feeling very sad. 

Suddenly Joe heard a distant sound coming closer. He looked around and he saw a small cat walking towards him. Joe felt a bit better and he stopped crying. 

The cat purred and rubbed up against Joes's chest. Joe was happy and he smiled. After that day, Joe was never lonely again. He and the cat were friends forever and ever.

Today, Tony and his family went to the park to play. Tony wanted to have a lot of fun, so he didn't behave himself. He ran around and made too much noise.

When Tony's mom told him to stop, Tony started to throw a tantrum. Suddenly, Tony's dad brought out a lime. Tony was excited and stopped throwing his fit.

The lime was very tough and Tony's dad showed him how to peel it. When Tony peeled it, the lime's juice squirted in his face. Tony laughed and laughed. Everyone was glad Tony was behaving much better.

Afterwards, Tony enjoyed the juicy lime. He behaved well and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there were three friends. Their names were Jack, Ann, and Sam. One day, they decided to go to the zoo. They were so excited!

Jack got a ticket to enter the zoo. He was so happy and smiled at everyone. Ann was feeling a bit grumpy and also got her ticket. Now all three were ready to enter.

But when they got to the gate, something went wrong. The grumpy zoo keeper said Ann's ticket was not good. He said it was out of date. Ann started to cry and so Jack and Sam tried to help.

Jack and Sam begged the zoo keeper to let Ann in. They said they could be quiet and not cause any trouble. Finally, the grumpy zoo keeper gave in. He took Ann's ticket and told them they were allowed to enter.

The three friends were so excited! They all held hands as they walked into the zoo. It was the best day ever!

"Yay!" shouted Emma as her mommy and daddy walked into the room. "We are so happy to see you!" She clapped her hands in joy and eagerly ran to them.

"Hello Emma," Daddy said. "Did you miss us?"

Emma nodded her head fast and hugged them both on either side.

"We missed you too," Mommy said and kissed Emma on the cheek.

"Look what I got!" Emma said and showed them the present she had been carrying around.

Mommy and Daddy applauded as they saw what it was. Emma beamed with pride and hugged her present tight.

"That's wonderful!" Daddy said. "We're so proud of you!"

Mommy and Daddy applauded again as Emma hugged her present and laughed with glee. She was so happy that her parents were home and she was eager to show them all the cool things she had been doing.

Once upon a time, there was a big, long line at the grocery store. A little girl named Lily was waiting with her mommy. Lily was getting bored and asked her mommy when they could go home. Her mommy said they had to stay in line for a little while longer. 

Lily saw some candy on a shelf nearby and wanted to get it, but her mommy said no. Lily felt sad and wanted to leave the grocery store. But her mommy said they needed to stay and get food for dinner. 

Finally, after a long time, it was their turn to pay. Lily helped her mommy put the groceries in the cart and they walked out of the store. As they walked home, Lily felt happy that they got all the food they needed to make a yummy dinner.

Once upon a time, there was a train. The train was going to the station. The train was happy because it was going to see its friends at the station. But then, something bad happened. The train hit a tree and it stopped. 

The train was stuck and it couldn't move. The train was sad because it couldn't see its friends at the station. But then, the train had an idea. The train thought it could reverse and go back to the station. So, the train reversed and went back to the station. 

When the train got to the station, all its friends were happy to see it. They asked the train why it came back. The train told them about the tree and how it was stuck. The friends were sad that the train had a bad experience. But they were happy that the train came back to see them.

Once upon a time there was a unique deer. He liked to rock back and forth all day long. He lived in a big green meadow surrounded by tall trees. One day, the deer heard something he hadn't before. It was a small voice coming from the trees. 

The deer stepped closer to see what was making the noise. He noticed a tiny little squirrel, shaking a branch and shouting, "Wake up! Wake up!"

The deer tilted his head and asked, "What are you doing, little squirrel?"

The squirrel stopped shaking the branch and looked up at the deer. He said, "I'm trying to wake up my friend the rock."

The deer was surprised. He asked, "Your friend is a rock?"

The squirrel nodded and pointed at the big rock lying on the ground. He said, "Yes! He's been sleeping for a long time. Can you help me wake him up?" 

The deer smiled and said, "Sure, let's give it a try!"

The deer and the squirrel worked together to rock the rock back and forth. Finally, after a few minutes, the rock awoke and laughed with joy! 

The deer and the squirrel cheered and gave the rock a big hug. From then on, the deer, the squirrel, and the rock were the best of friends!

Mummy had a red wallet. She carried it with her everywhere she went. One day, she came home from work and came into the living room. She took the red wallet out of her bag and unpacked it. Inside, there were lots of pretty things! Mummy took them out one by one and put them on the table. There was a shiny white card, a green card with numbers, and a few coins. Mummy smiled as she looked everything over. She was very happy. 

Then, Mummy put all the things back in the wallet and closed it. She put the red wallet back in her bag and went upstairs to take a nap. Later, Mummy went out again and took her red wallet with her. 

The end.

Once there was a mole who lived on a farm. It was a very nice, mild day and the mole was content.

Suddenly, the mole heard a noise. It was a farmer! The farmer was carrying something big and he wanted to send it somewhere. He looked around and spotted the mole.

The farmer smiled. He had an important job for the mole. He asked if it would be willing to take the big package and send it to his daughter who lived far away.

The mole was happy to help. It took the package in its mouth and set off. Eventually, the mole made it to the far away town and delivered the package to the surprised daughter.

The mole was tired but proud of its mission. It returned to the farm and settled down in its cozy hole just as the sun began to set. All was peaceful and mild.

Once, there was a little bird who dreamed of soaring through the sky. Every day, he hopped around the nest and watched the other birds above him. He wanted to be just like them.

One day, he plucked up the courage to try. He puffed out his chest and flapped his wings as hard as he could.  Then, he took off! He soared above the trees and smiled with joy.

When it was time to land, he looked for somewhere safe. He spotted a round, metal pan near the ground and hopped inside. It was warm and comfortable, and he kept it as a new home.

The little bird never tried to fly again. He was too shy. But, he was happy to have soared in the sky that day.

Once upon a time there was an ancient and wise crab. He lived near the beach, close to the sea.

The crab would catch shrimp every day. One day he noticed something strange. All the shrimp were clapping their hands! 

â€œWhatâ€™s this?â€ exclaimed the crab. But the shrimp said nothing.

The crab asked again. This time the shrimp replied. â€œWe are applauding to show our respect for the sharks. They are much bigger, and much wiser than us.â€

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat tuna sandwiches for lunch. One day, her mom bought a new can of tuna from the store. 

Lily was so excited to try the new tuna. She measured out just the right amount to put on her sandwich. It tasted really good! 

Later that day, Lily went to the park with her friends. They played on the swings and the slide. When it was time to go home, Lily's mom measured her height to see how much she had grown. 

Lily was happy to see that she was a little bit taller than last time. She went home and had another tuna sandwich for dinner. It was a very good day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his ball. One day, Timmy went to play outside and his ball rolled away from him. Timmy tried to get his ball back, but it rolled down a big hill and into a well.

Timmy was sad because he thought he would never see his ball again. But then, Timmy remembered something his mommy told him. She said, "If something is hard to do, just take it easy and don't give up."

So, Timmy took a deep breath and went to get his ball. He climbed down into the well and rolled the ball back up to the top. Timmy was so happy that he didn't give up and got his ball back. From that day on, Timmy remembered to take it easy and never give up when things get hard.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat liked to sail on the water. One day, a man wanted to sail the boat. The man did not know much about boats. He was ignorant.

The man saw a big pit in the water. He did not know what it was. The boat tried to tell the man about the pit, but the man did not listen. The boat was scared.

The man sailed the boat right into the pit. The boat sank into the water. The man was very sad. The boat was gone. The man learned he should listen and learn before sailing a boat.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play at the beach. They see the big blue waves and the white sand. They want to test how brave they are.

"Let's go in the water!" Tim says. He runs to the edge of the water and splashes his feet.

"Wait for me!" Sam says. He follows Tim and feels the cold water on his toes.

They laugh and jump in the water. They see the waves coming and going. They try to catch the waves and ride them.

"Look at me!" Tim says. He stands on a wave and balances. He feels like a surfer.

"Wow, you are so good!" Sam says. He claps his hands and cheers.

But then a big wave comes. It is bigger than Tim and Sam. It makes a loud noise and pushes them down.

"Help!" Tim says. He is scared and wants to get out.

"Grab my hand!" Sam says. He reaches for Tim and pulls him up.

They swim to the shore and cough out the water. They are wet and cold and tired.

"That was a big wave!" Tim says. He shivers and hugs Sam.

"That was too big!" Sam says. He nods and hugs Tim back.

They are happy they are safe. They are happy they are friends. They decide to test something else.

"Let's build a sandcastle!" Tim says.

"Let's do it!" Sam says.

They run to the sand and start to dig and pile and decorate. They forget about the big wave and have fun. They are brave and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved cookies very much. One day, her mommy baked some cookies and put them on the table to cool down. Lily saw the cookies and wanted to touch them, but her mommy said, "No, Lily. You can't touch the cookies yet. They are still hot."

Lily felt sad and jealous because she wanted to eat a cookie. She said, "Mommy, I want a cookie now!" But her mommy said, "Not yet, Lily. You have to wait until they cool down." 

Lily waited and waited, but she was still jealous of the cookies. Finally, her mommy said, "Okay, Lily. You can have a cookie now." Lily was so happy and she ate the cookie with a big smile on her face. From that day on, Lily learned to be patient and wait for things she wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a big brown bear. He loved to chew on honey and berries. One day, he went for a walk in the forest and found a cave. He went inside to explore and found an exit at the back. 

As he was walking towards the exit, he saw a little rabbit stuck in a trap. The bear felt sad for the rabbit and decided to help him. He chewed the rope that was holding the trap and set the rabbit free. The rabbit was very grateful and thanked the bear.

From that day on, the bear and the rabbit became friends. They would often meet at the cave and share honey and berries. The bear was happy to have made a new friend and the rabbit was happy to have been saved by the kind bear.

Once upon a time, there were two friends: Poppy and Tom. They joined each other for play every day. One day Poppy had a coin, but Tom did not have a coin. Tom was sad, so Poppy shared her coin with him so that they could join in playing together. Tom was so happy and he hugged Poppy. They played together happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars. One day, Timmy's mom took him to the park to play. Timmy brought his toy cars with him.

While Timmy was playing, he crashed his toy car into a big rock. "Oh no, my car is wrecked!" Timmy cried. His mom hugged him and said, "Don't worry, we can fix it."

Later that day, Timmy's mom put the toy car in the freezer to make it cold. When she took it out, the car had melted! "What happened?" Timmy asked. "The cold made the car melt," his mom explained. "It's an unknown thing that can happen to some toys." Timmy was sad that his car was gone, but he was happy to have learned something new.

One day, Jake and his mom went to the movies. Jake was excited because he loves popcorn! As they entered the theater, Jake saw a popcorn machine. He decided he wanted some. His mom agreed that it would be a good idea and they bought a big bag of popcorn.

Once they found their seats, Jake started eating the popcorn. It was so crunchy and delicious. As he ate, he noticed that some of the kernels had fallen on the floor. He decided to pick them up and put them back in the bag. His mom thought that was very useful!

Jake ate all of the popcorn. He had so much fun eating it, he decided to get more. He asked his mom and she said yes. With a big smile, Jake ran to get more popcorn. He was so excited! He couldn't wait to eat it!

Once upon a time, there lived two friends, Tom and Sam. Tom had a very fierce toy, a lion. Sam asked Tom, if he could lend him his fierce toy. Tom happily agreed and said â€œYes!â€ Sam was so happy that he hugged Tom and thanked him.

Tom lent Sam the fierce toy and asked him to take care of it. Sam was so excited to have the fierce toy that he proudly told everyone about it. Everyone was so surprised that the fierce toy belonged to Sam and not to Tom.

But one day, something unexpected happened. Sam lost the fierce toy and he was so worried that he cried. He asked everyone if they have seen the fierce toy. But unfortunately, no one knew where it was. 

Tom, seeing his friend was so sad, offered to help. He looked for the fierce toy in every corner and luckily found it. Sam was so happy and he thanked Tom for lending him the toy and for his help. From then on, Tom and Sam were the best of friends.

Lily and Ben like to play with their toy cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. They also have a big truck that can load and unload the cars.

One day, they decide to have a race with their cars. They load some cars on the truck and drive it to the park. They find a nice spot with a hill and a path. They unload the cars and line them up at the top of the hill.

"Ready, set, go!" Lily says, and they push their cars down the hill. The cars zoom and roll and bounce on the path. Some cars are fast and some are slow. Some cars are shiny and some are old. Lily and Ben cheer for their cars and laugh.

But then, they hear a loud bark. A big dog is running towards them. The dog likes the cars too. He wants to play with them. He chases the cars and tries to catch them in his mouth. He knocks over some cars and makes them fly.

Lily and Ben are scared. They love their cars. They don't want the dog to break them. They run to the truck and load their cars as fast as they can. They hop on the truck and drive away.

The dog is sad. He just wanted to have fun. He barks and runs after the truck, but he can't catch it. He stops and sits on the hill. He is quiet and lonely.

Lily and Ben are safe. They drive back to their home. They unload their cars and put them away. They hug each other and smile.

They are happy. They have many cars of different styles. They also have a big truck that can load and unload the cars. They like to play with their cars. They also like to be quiet and cozy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a bird flying high in the sky. She said, "Look, a bird! It's so pretty!"

Her friend, Jack, said, "I want to climb that tree over there. Do you want to come with me?" Lily replied, "Yes, I love to climb trees!" 

So, they both climbed the tree. It was a big tree and they had to climb high to reach the top. When they finally made it to the top, they saw the bird again. It was flying around and making a loud noise. Lily said, "The bird is so loud!" 

Jack said, "Maybe it's trying to tell us something." They both listened carefully to the bird's chirping. Suddenly, they heard their mom calling them for lunch. They climbed down the tree and ran back home, excited to tell their mom about their adventure.

Once upon a time there was a generous bulb. It was a very special bulb because it wanted to be part of something bigger. So one day it asked if it could join a new family.

The family said yes and welcomed the bulb into their home. Everyone was so happy. The bulb lit up the room with a warm light that everyone enjoyed.

The bulb was so excited to be part of the family. Every day it shared its light with them. It would light up their home and make them smile.

One day, the bulb suggested a special game. Every family member had to join in with the bulb. They ran, jumped and laughed. It was so much fun and everyone was happy to be part of the game.

The bulb was so pleased to be part of the family. The bulb knew it had found a special home and the family was filled with love and light.

Ben and Mia are playing in the garden. They have a spray bottle and a can of tuna. They want to make a surprise for their cat, Luna.

"Let's spray some water on the tuna and put it on the grass," Ben says. "Then Luna will smell it and come to eat it."

"OK, but we have to hide behind the tree," Mia says. "Or Luna will see us and run away."

They spray some water on the tuna and open the can. They put it on the grass and run to hide behind the tree. They wait and watch.

Soon, Luna comes out of the house. She sniffs the air and walks towards the tuna. She looks around and sees no one. She thinks it is her lucky day.

She starts to eat the tuna, but it is wet and cold. She does not like it. She makes a face and spits it out. She meows loudly.

Ben and Mia laugh. They think they are very clever. They come out of their hiding place and call Luna.

"Luna, Luna, come here! We have a joke for you!" they say.

But Luna is not happy. She feels tricked and angry. She hisses and runs away. She does not want to play with them.

Ben and Mia are sad. They did not mean to make Luna mad. They love their cat. They want to say sorry.

They go inside the house and look for Luna. They find her under the bed. They have a bowl of dry tuna and a toy mouse. They try to coax her out.

"Luna, Luna, we are sorry! We have a treat for you! And a toy! Please come out and play with us!" they say.

Luna peeks out from under the bed. She sees the bowl of tuna and the toy mouse. She smells them and feels curious. She thinks maybe Ben and Mia are not so bad after all.

She comes out of her hiding place and walks towards them. She rubs her head against their legs and purrs. She forgives them.

Ben and Mia are happy. They hug Luna and give her the tuna and the toy. They play with her and tell her she is a good and clever cat. They promise not to spray her again.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a mom and a dad and their daughter. The mom and dad decided to take their daughter to the park. They were so excited to show her the fun they could have.

They arrived at the park and the daughter was ecstatic! She ran around, jumping and laughing. The parents watched her with smiles on their faces.

Mom said, "Let's pass the ball together!" The daughter grabbed it and quickly passed it to dad. He passed it back and she giggled with excitement. They continued to pass the ball for a few minutes. 

"Do you have fun, daughter?" Dad asked. 

"Yes, so much fun!" She replied enthusiastically. 

The mom and dad hugged their daughter and thanked her for being such a joy. They spent the rest of their time at the park happily playing together.

Once there was a little girl named Abigail. She always wanted to sail away in a boat. One day she asked her parents if she could take the boat for a sail. They said yes, but to be careful.

Abigail was so excited! She wrapped up a few snacks, then she hopped into the boat. She sailed fast and far away, until she couldn't see her parents anymore.

Abigail loved her adventure. But then the wind got stronger and the boat tipped over. Abigail was scared and began to cry. She grabbed onto a wrap, then hung on as tight as she could.

After a long time, Abigail was finally rescued and brought back to shore. Her parents were relieved, but Abigail was sad. She never got to sail away in her boat again.

Once upon a time, there was a panda. She liked to peek out of her cave early in the morning. One morning, she saw something easy. It was a small bird, chirping happily and singing a lovely tune. The panda was so surprised that she didn't know what to do. Then the bird flew away.

The panda wanted to look for the bird, so she decided to go on an adventure. She peeked out of her cave many times, searching for the bird. Finally, the panda heard the bird singing again. It was happy to see her and they both enjoyed a nice chat.

The friendship between the panda and the bird was growing and they became the best of friends. Every day, the panda peeked out of her cave to see if her friend had returned. Finally, with a smile on her face, the panda found the bird again. They sang together and enjoyed the gorgeous day in the forest.

The panda and the bird were together again - it was an easy and happy day.

Once upon a time, two friends were walking in the landscape. They were talking and laughing, having a great time together.

"Look at the fair sky!" said one friend.

"Yes, it is beautiful!" said the other.

Suddenly, the first friend started to run. He ran faster and faster, and soon, he reached the edge of the landscape.

"What are you doing?" shouted the other friend. 

The first friend ignored him, and wanted to jump off the edge.

"NO!" shouted the other friend, and he rushed over. He went over and slapped the first friend on the shoulder.

The first friend was angry. He shouted, "Why did you do that?" 

"You shouldn't do something just because it looks fun," said the other friend. "It isn't always fair to ignore the rules".

The first friend thought about it for a moment, and he realized that his friend was right. He thanked his friend for showing him what was fair and for helping him make better choices. 

The two friends smiled at each other, and from then on, they were always careful to make sure they followed the rules.

"Come on, Mommy!" said three-year-old Dylan excitedly. "Let's sail!"

Dylan and Mommy got ready to go. Mommy packed a picnic and Dylan brought his stuffed animal.

At the beach, Dylan and Mommy got in the boat and sailed away. The sun shone brightly and the water was blue and sparkly.

Soon enough, they were sailing out to sea, looking for dolphins. Dylan was so excited he couldn't even sit still.

On the way, Dylan and Mommy smelled the sweet smell of coffee coming from a famous boat. 

"Let's sail over there and get a cup of delicious coffee!â€ Dylan cried out. So, Dylan and Mommy sailed up to the boat. They decided to take some of the famous coffee home for later.

They both said goodbye to the boat and sailed home, feeling happy and refreshed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and would often twirl around her room. One day, she saw a popular dance show on TV and asked her mommy if they could go see it.

Mommy said yes and they went to the show. Lily was so excited to observe the dancers on stage. They were so good and she wanted to be just like them one day.

But during the show, there was a loud noise and the dancers stopped dancing. Everyone started to run and scream. Lily was scared and didn't know what was happening. Mommy told her they needed to leave quickly.

Later, they found out that there was a fire in the theater. Lily was sad that they didn't get to see the end of the show and she didn't understand why something bad had to happen. But mommy hugged her and said they were lucky to be safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to run and play in the park. One day, Max saw a pretty butterfly and started to chase it. But as he was running, he got his collar stuck on a branch. Max tried to pull himself free, but he couldn't. 

Just then, a little girl saw Max and came to help him. She gently touched his collar and untangled it from the branch. Max was so happy and grateful. He realized how important it was to have friends who help you when you're in trouble. 

From that day on, Max always made sure to stay close to his friends and never wander too far away. He knew that having friends was the most important thing of all.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim was a very creative bird. He liked to make things with his wings. One day, Tim saw a big window. He had a plan to make something fun.

Tim flew around and found sticks, leaves, and mud. He used these to build a beautiful nest near the window. The nest was very colorful and strong. Tim was proud of his work. He invited all his friends to see it.

Tim's friends loved the nest too. They learned that if they work hard and use their creative ideas, they can make something nice. The moral of the story is, always use your creativity and plan well to make something great.

Once there was a person. The person was gentle and liked to talk. One day, this person was walking in the street and they saw a little girl. The person stopped to talk to the little girl.

The person smiled at the little girl and said, "Hello! What is your name?".

The little girl smiled back and said, "My name is Patricia".

The person said, "That's a very pretty name! What are you doing?".

Patricia said, "I'm playing with my dolls".

The person smiled and said, "Oh, how fun! Can I join you?".

Patricia said, "Sure! Let's play together!".

The person and Patricia played together for a long time. They talked and laughed. They had so much fun! When it was time to say goodbye, the person gave Patricia a gentle hug and waved goodbye.

Patricia waved back and said, "Goodbye! Come back and play soon!".

The person smiled and said, "I will! Goodbye, Patricia".

Once upon a time there was a big bear. He had lots of power, so he could do anything he wanted. He wanted to spend his power wisely, so he decided to find a good way to use it.

He thought and thought until he had a good idea. He decided to spend his power to make something nice for all the other animals.

He used his power to build a big treehouse. Every day, he invited all the animals over to play in the treehouse. They all had so much fun swinging from the branches and sliding down the slide.

The bear had spent all his power building the treehouse and the animals were so happy. Now, every day, all the animals come to the big bear's treehouse to play and be happy.

Once upon a time there was a sailor. He was wearing a brown coat and he had a brown hat. One day, he was walking on the beach and he saw a tiny creature. He shouted "Hello! What are you?

The creature replied. "I'm a seagull! What are you?"

The sailor said, "I'm a sailor. I sail the seas looking for adventure!"

The seagull was happy to hear this and shouted "Wow! That sounds exciting!"

The sailor said "Would you like to come sailing with me?"

The seagull replied "Yes! I'd love to!"

So the sailor and the seagull sailed away into the sunset. They had lots of fun and they made many new friends. They were very happy.

Once upon a time two friends, kids named Jack and Jill, were playing together. Jack was jumping into a pool, hoping to make a big splash.

Jill watched from the edge: "Jack, don't dive too deep!"

But Jack didn't listen and dived in as deep as he could.

Jill was worried so she followed Jack and dived after him. She caught up with him and they both bobbed up to the top of the pool together.

Jack smiled at Jill and said: "Thanks for finding me. You're very polite."

Jill laughed. "It's alright. We should stay at the top though, ok?"

Jack agreed. They swam around the top of the pool and had lots of fun. The time went too quickly and before they knew it, it was time to go home.

Both Jack and Jill hugged each other goodbye and promised to play together soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to hop around and play with her toys. One day, Lily's aunt came to visit her. Her aunt was very nice and had a peaceful smile on her face.

Lily was very happy to see her aunt and they played together all day. They sang songs, danced and even made some cookies. Lily's aunt was very good at baking.

As the day went on, Lily started to feel sleepy. Her aunt tucked her into bed and read her a story. Lily felt very peaceful and happy as she fell asleep, dreaming about all the fun things she did with her aunt that day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to enjoy playing outside. One hot day, she saw a letter on the ground. The letter was pretty and colorful. Sue picked up the letter and wanted to see what it said.

Sue took the letter to her mom. Her mom read the letter out loud. The letter said, "If you enjoy this hot day, you will find a big surprise." Sue got very excited. She wanted to find the surprise.

Sue and her mom looked all around the yard. They looked under rocks, in the bushes, and behind the tree. They could not find the surprise. Sue felt sad. The hot day was not fun anymore. The letter did not tell the truth. Sue and her mom went inside, and they did not find the surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She lived in a village with her mom and dad. 

One Sunday morning, Amy and her parents went to the market. When they arrived, there were all sorts of wonderful things to buy! Amy saw the fruits and vegetables and the colorful ribbons and balloons. She even saw some really exciting herbs.

"What is that, Mommy?" she asked, pointing to an herb.

"That is a herb," her mom said.

But then something strange happened. Suddenly, an angry man appeared in the market. Everyone in the market got scared and started to run away.

Amy and her parents ran back home as fast as they could. They were very frightened, but soon they arrived back home safely.

The next day, Amy and her parents decided to go back to the market. This time, they were careful and nothing bad happened. Amy got to buy lots of new herbs and take them home with her.

From then on, Amy had plenty of herbs to play with. She always remembered that scary day in the market and the angry man. But she was happy to be safe and have so much fun with herbs!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. He had a favorite toy car that he loved to play with, but the switch on the car was broken. Timmy asked his mommy if he could fix the switch, but she said it was too harsh for him to do by himself.

One day, Timmy's mommy permitted him to go to the toy store to buy a new toy car. Timmy was so excited! He went to the toy store and found the perfect toy car with a working switch. He played with it all day and was so happy. Timmy learned that sometimes it's okay to ask for help, and that it's important to listen to grown-ups when they say something is too harsh for you to do on your own.

Once upon a time there was a old man and an old woman. They were very kind. One day the old woman mentioned that she wanted a lamp. She said it would make her room brighter. The old man wanted to make it easier for her, so he asked the children for help.

The children gladly agreed and went out searching for a lamp. After a few hours the children came back with the perfect lamp! It was very easy for them to find.

The old woman was so happy when she saw the lamp. She thanked the children for helping her. From then on, the old woman lit the lamp every day.

The moral of the story is that by helping others, we can make things easier for them.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help her in the kitchen. She said, "Timmy, can you count how many potatoes we need for dinner tonight?" Timmy counted the potatoes and said, "We need five potatoes, Mommy!"

As Timmy and his mom were cooking, they heard a knock at the door. It was their neighbor, Mrs. Smith. She had a big turkey with her and she said, "I have too much turkey for my family. Would you like to have some, Timmy and Mommy?" Timmy's mom said, "Yes please, Mrs. Smith! Thank you so much!" 

Timmy's mom was careful when she cooked the turkey, making sure it was cooked just right. When dinner was ready, Timmy's dad came home and they all sat down to eat. Timmy said, "Mommy, this turkey is so yummy! Thank you for being careful when you cooked it." Everyone laughed and enjoyed their delicious dinner together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to write stories about dragons and princesses. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help her iron some clothes. Timmy didn't want to stop writing, but he knew he had to help his mom.

As Timmy was ironing, he accidentally burned a hole in his favorite shirt. He felt ashamed and didn't want to tell his mom what happened. But his mom noticed the hole and asked him what happened.

"I'm sorry, Mom. I burned a hole in my shirt while I was ironing," Timmy said.

"It's okay, Timmy. It was just an accident. Next time, be more careful," his mom replied.

Timmy learned that it's important to be honest when something goes wrong, even if it makes you feel ashamed. And he continued to write his stories about dragons and princesses, while also helping his mom with the ironing. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to travel to new places with his family. One day, they went to a park and Timmy saw a cool zip line. He wanted to try it so he asked his dad, "Can I go on the zip?" His dad said yes and helped him put on a harness. Timmy climbed up the ladder and then he zipped down the line. It was so cool! When he got to the end, he shouted, "That was fun! Can we do it again?"

Lily and Ben went to the zoo with Mom and Dad. They saw many animals, like lions, monkeys, and giraffes. Lily liked the penguins best. They were black and white and funny. Ben liked the elephants best. They were big and gray and strong.

They ate ice cream and popcorn and drank juice. They were very happy. But then, Lily saw a big sign that said "Lost and Found". She thought it was a place to find more animals. She ran to the sign and opened the door. But there were no animals inside. There were only coats and hats and bags.

Lily was scared. She did not know where she was. She did not see Mom and Dad or Ben. She started to cry. She wanted to go back to the penguins. She panicked.

Ben saw Lily run away. He followed her. He saw her go inside the Lost and Found. He went after her. He saw her crying. He hugged her. He said, "Don't cry, Lily. I'm here. We'll find Mom and Dad. They're looking for us. Come on, let's go outside."

He took her hand and led her out of the door. They saw a nice lady with a badge. She smiled at them. She said, "Are you lost, kids? I can help you. What are your names?" Ben told her their names. He said, "We're looking for Mom and Dad. They're at the zoo. We got lost."

The lady said, "Don't worry, Ben and Lily. I'll call your Mom and Dad on the phone. They'll come and get you. You're very brave. Do you want some water?" She gave them each a cup of water. They drank it. They felt better. They thanked the lady.

Soon, they heard Mom and Dad's voices. They ran to them. They hugged them. Mom and Dad were so happy to see them. They said, "We're sorry, Ben and Lily. We were so worried. We're glad you're safe. How did you get lost?"

Ben and Lily told them what happened. They said they were sorry, too. They said they learned a lesson. They said they would never run away again. They said they loved Mom and Dad. Mom and Dad said they loved them, too.

They all went back to the zoo. They saw more animals. They had more fun. But they stayed together. They did not get dizzy or panic again. They had a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jack. He liked to explore the world around him. One day, he went for a walk in the park when he saw something special. He found a sparkly box with a big, red button on the side. He stopped and looked up at it and wondered what was inside. 

Jack cautiously pressed the button and the box opened. He was filled with excitement as he saw a beautiful wand inside the box with a note attached. He read the note and it said, "This wand will give you magic. Use it wisely."

Jack took the wand out of the box and started to wave it around. Suddenly, a voice came from the box, "Hello, Jack. Are you ready to learn magic?".

Jack was amazed and said, "Yes, please show me".

The voice said, "With this wand, you will learn how to do many fun things. Whenever you need help, just wave the wand and say the magic words. You will know when it is available to use".

Jack smiled and thanked the voice for the magic wand. He was excited to start trying out his new magical powers. He waved the wand and wished for a lollipop which appeared in his hand. He giggled with joy and knew he had found a wonderful magical friend.

Lily liked to help her mom in the kitchen. She wanted to work like a big girl. She saw her mom cut some carrots with a knife. Lily asked, "Can I cut too?"

Mom smiled and said, "No, Lily, cutting is not for little hands. You can use a fork to poke the carrots. That is your work."

Lily took a fork and poked the carrots. She liked the sound they made. She poked and poked until all the carrots were on a plate. She was very patient and careful.

Mom said, "Good job, Lily! You worked very well. Now we can cook the carrots for dinner. Do you want to stir them in the pot?"

Lily nodded and said, "Yes, please!" She put down her fork and climbed on a stool. Mom gave her a wooden spoon and showed her how to stir. Lily stirred and stirred until the carrots were soft and yummy.

Mom said, "You are a great helper, Lily. I am proud of you. Now we can eat the carrots. Do you want some?"

Lily said, "Yes, please! I love carrots. They are my favorite." She took her fork and ate some carrots. She shared them with her mom. They were both happy and full.

One day, a little girl named Jessie was in her classroom. She was playing a game and having a lot of fun. All of a sudden, she heard a voice shouting from the other side of the room. She ran over to see what it was all about.

In the corner of the classroom, Jessie saw a big, red fire-truck. She was so excited she couldn't help but shout out loud.

"Fire trucks are so good," said Jessie.

The fireman who was driving the truck said, "Yes they are, Jessie. And I work hard to help keep people safe."

Jessie smiled and said, "Good job! You're the best fireman ever!"

The fireman gave her a big thumbs up and said, "Thanks Jessie, that's very kind of you!"

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom liked to sleep all day and didn't like to play with his friends. One day, Tom's friend, a curious mouse named Max, went on an adventure to discover new things.

Max found a big box with a ruler inside. He didn't know what it was, but he wanted to measure things with it. So, he took the ruler and went back to Tom's house.

When Max got to Tom's house, he saw Tom sleeping on the couch. Max wanted to measure how long Tom was, so he used the ruler to measure Tom's body. To his surprise, Tom was longer than he thought!

Tom woke up and saw Max measuring him. He was surprised too! Tom realized that he had been lazy and wanted to discover new things too. From that day on, Tom and Max went on many adventures together, measuring and discovering new things.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. He dreamed of being wise. One day, he found a white egg in the forest. He thought it was so special that he took it home.

The next day, the egg hatches, and out came a snowman! The little boy was so excited that the snowman was alive.

The snowman was kind, and full of wisdom. He told the boy stories and taught him important lessons.

One day it was so cold outside, the snowman started to freeze! The little boy wanted to save his new friend, so he made a plan. He grabbed all of his warm blankets and wrapped the snowman up tightly.

The snowman stayed warm and safe. From then on, the boy and snowman shared special adventures, and the little boy was always learning new wisdom!

Once upon a time, there was a ship. It was blue and yellow with lots of fun things to do. One day, three friends went for a ride on the ship. They were excited to slide down the big slide.

The first two friends went down the slide quickly, but the third friend was very thoughtful. He thought about which way would be the most fun. After much thinking, the third friend decided to slide down backward. He laughed and giggled all the way down the slide.

When they reached the bottom, the three friends noticed something very exciting. There were lots and lots of colorful balloons! The friends were excited and ran around chasing the balloons.

The friends had lots of fun, but eventually it was time to go. As they said their goodbyes, the friends thanked the thoughtful third friend for choosing the perfect slide. They said goodbye with big hugs and waved as the ship sailed away.

Anna and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park and look for shiny things. One day, they found a big, bright diamond in the grass. They were very happy and excited.

"Wow, look at this!" Anna said. "It is so pretty and sparkly. Can we keep it?"

"Of course we can," Ben said. "It is ours now. We found it fair and square."

They put the diamond in their pocket and ran to show their moms. But on the way, they saw a lady crying on a bench. She looked very sad and lost.

"Excuse me, miss," Anna said. "Why are you crying?"

The lady looked up and saw the children. She wiped her tears and smiled a little.

"Hello, dear. You are very kind to ask. I am crying because I lost my diamond ring. It was a gift from my husband, and it means a lot to me. I dropped it somewhere in the park, and I can't find it."

Anna and Ben felt sorry for the lady. They looked at each other and remembered the diamond in their pocket. They knew what they had to do.

"Miss, we have something to tell you," Ben said. "We found your diamond ring. It was in the grass over there. We are sorry we took it. We didn't know it was yours."

They gave the diamond back to the lady. She was overjoyed and hugged them.

"Thank you, thank you, thank you!" she said. "You are very honest and brave. You made me so happy. You can have this as a reward." She gave them each a candy bar.

Anna and Ben smiled and thanked the lady. They learned a valuable lesson that day. They learned that it is better to be truthful and generous than to be greedy and selfish. They also learned that sometimes, delaying what you want can lead to something better. They were very intelligent and good friends.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. Sarah was walking in the woods and it was so quite. She saw some witch berries and she tried to pick one. Suddenly, she slipped and fell.

Sarah looked up and saw a big, scary witch! The witch said to Sarah in a loud voice, "What are you doing in the woods?!"

Sarah was so scared that she couldn't move. Then the witch spoke again, but in a more quiet voice. She said to Sarah, "I will not hurt you. I just want to know why you were trying to pick my witch berries."

Sarah apologized for taking the berries and told the witch she was hungry. The witch smiled and said, "I know a way for you to get some food. Pick the witch berries and take them home with you. They're very yummy!"

Sarah thanked the witch for her kindness and happily picked up a basket of witch berries. She said goodbye to the friendly witch, and skipped home with her basket of treats.

Once upon a time there was a skeleton who had done something bad. Nobody wanted to be his friend anymore, and he felt so sad. He wanted to make things right, so he asked everyone to forgive him.
